files_or_snippet: TokenStream tokenizer: constructor/newToken/next, isWhitespace, isRadixInteger, isNumber, isName (dist/index.mjs lines ~539-910)
how_adapted: Converted to an ES class; removed string/comment/bracket/named-op/const scanning; isName restricted to ASCII [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*; exponent only scanned after a valid mantissa; added single-char operator scanning; errors raised as CalcError with position. Parser (with implicit multiplication and the spec precedence), evaluator, built-ins, calculator state and REPL are new code written for this project, since expr-eval's grammar differs.
